summary: Design agent produced LLD v2.0 for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). The LLD is a post-implementation verified document incorporating all learnings from the full implementation cycle (PRs #48, #75, #77, #80-84). Key verified facts: detectOrphanedSession() is the correct API name, 30s auto-save interval, fake-indexeddb/auto for unit tests, browser.close({ runBeforeUnload: false }) for crash simulation, idb in dependencies (not devDependencies).

artifacts.name: LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md
artifacts.description: Full LLD v2.0: IndexedDB schema, service interfaces, Zustand store contract, hook contract, 4 sequence diagrams, atomicity guarantee, error handling, security, performance budget, accessibility, test case mapping, implementation checklist

recommended_actions: Use detectOrphanedSession() (NOT detectCrash()) as the crash detection API
Use fake-indexeddb/auto for Vitest unit tests (devDependency)
Use browser.close({ runBeforeUnload: false }) for Playwright crash simulation
Ensure idb is in dependencies (not devDependencies) — required at runtime
All data-testid selectors: resume-prompt, resume-prompt-brick-count, resume-btn, discard-btn, add-brick-btn, brick-instance, auto-save-status
